services.desc: Watch a Florida sunset paint the sky in vivid color as you drift along tranquil waterways. Soft music and gentle waves set the mood. Perfect for a romantic moment, a family unwind, or an evening with friends. Bring your own drinks to enjoy aboard our cozy 26-foot pontoon boat while keeping an eye out for native wildlife. Relax, soak in the serenity, and make it an unforgettable sunset. As the animals we encounter are wild and untrained, we can never guarantee wildlife sightings. services.name: Wildlife tour
services.desc: Experience marine life like never before on our unforgettable 2-hour tours through the beautiful waterways departing from Cape Crossing Marina in Merritt Island. Departing from Cape Crossing Marina - home to the largest tiki bar and restaurant in Brevard County - your 2-hour adventure begins in a vibrant waterfront setting before cruising east toward the scenic Banana River Lagoon, which separates Merritt Island from Cocoa Beach. As you travel just south of the Merritt Island National Wildlife Refuge, you’ll discover one of Florida’s most diverse ecosystems, home to dolphins, manatees, native birds, and breathtaking waterfront views. services.name: Browse Tours
services.desc: Celebrate on the water with a private Cruise Cocoa charter along Florida’s beautiful Space Coast. Departing from Ballard Park, our 2-hour cruise travels through the scenic Indian River Lagoon, past historic Dragon Point, and into the breathtaking Banana River Lagoon creating the perfect backdrop for unforgettable private events and special occasions. Whether you’re planning a birthday party, bachelorette party, holiday celebration, family reunion, corporate outing, team-building event, or just a fun gathering with friends, Cruise Cocoa offers a relaxed and memorable experience on the water for up to 23 passengers.
